recommendation: Keep the fix. It restores approved FHIR-13630 semantics to the active ServiceRequest successor while preserving later-approved target profiles, current terminology, and Procedure.reason wording.
issue_request: FHIR-13630 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 OO issue asking Procedure and ProcedureRequest reasonReference to permit DiagnosticReport and DocumentReference, with comments clarifying that report/document references should contain findings that justify the follow-up request.
initial_application: Commit ab9c1bd7f48d954924628ca167dbc5a912901bcb explicitly pre-applied GF#13630 by adding DiagnosticReport and DocumentReference to ProcedureRequest.reasonReference and adding the approved findings-language comment. The target types survived the ProcedureRequest-to-ServiceRequest transition, but later source rework and the CodeableReference merge carried forward only the shorter merged reason comment, dropping the report/document-specific guidance.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ServiceRequest and Procedure as active resources and records ProcedureRequest as merged into ServiceRequest. Later issues FHIR-13867, FHIR-16681, FHIR-47851, and FHIR-32510 govern the current resource name, DiagnosticReport.conclusionCode element name, ServiceRequest wording, and Procedure.reason comment scope. The related FHIR-13756 comment issue and FHIR-47851 were already represented on the combined branch, so this commit only reconciles FHIR-13630.
reconciliation: Updated source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml so ServiceRequest.reason again says DiagnosticReport references should contain findings in DiagnosticReport.conclusion and/or DiagnosticReport.conclusionCode, and DocumentReference targets should contain clear findings language providing the relevant reason. Updated source/servicerequest/servicerequest-request-mapping-exceptions.xml with the matching comment copy.
source_changes: source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml: restored DiagnosticReport.conclusion/DiagnosticReport.conclusionCode and DocumentReference clear-findings guidance in the ServiceRequest.reason comment.
source/servicerequest/servicerequest-request-mapping-exceptions.xml: synchronized the Request mapping exception copy of the ServiceRequest.reason comment.

related_jiras.note: Companion ProcedureRequest reason comment issue applied in the same historical commit and already audited on the combined branch; the restored wording preserves its current request-purpose clarification.
Renamed/merged ProcedureRequest into ServiceRequest, establishing ServiceRequest.reason as the active successor source surface.
Renamed DiagnosticReport.codedDiagnosis to DiagnosticReport.conclusionCode; the restored guidance uses the current element name.
Later Applied issue added Procedure to ServiceRequest.reason and refined the same comment from referral to request; this fix preserves those edits while restoring FHIR-13630-specific guidance.
Later Procedure.reason-specific comment decision explains why this reconciliation did not edit Procedure.reason prose.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 OO issue requesting DiagnosticReport and DocumentReference reasonReference targets plus ProcedureRequest.reasonReference comments about report/document findings.
evidence_items.learned: The approved change included both the target expansion and explanatory findings guidance.

evidence_items.summary: The origin thread discusses follow-up imaging based on findings in a DiagnosticReport and records that GF#13630 was filed for ProcedureRequest.reasonReference to include DiagnosticReport.
evidence_items.learned: The use case supports guidance that report/document references should actually contain findings relevant to the request reason.

evidence_items.summary: Historical application commit added DiagnosticReport and DocumentReference to ProcedureRequest.reasonReference and inserted the approved findings-language comment.
evidence_items.learned: The missing current comment text was once present in authoritative source for this issue.

evidence_items.summary: Later source rework and CodeableReference merge retained ServiceRequest.reason target profiles but merged to the shorter comment that omitted DiagnosticReport/DocumentReference findings guidance.
evidence_items.learned: The omission is attributable to refactoring drift rather than an identified reversal of FHIR-13630.

evidence_items.summary: ServiceRequest is active, ProcedureRequest is retired/merged into ServiceRequest, and ServiceRequest.reason now carries the restored DiagnosticReport/DocumentReference findings guidance in both source and mapping exception copy.
evidence_items.learned: The source change is in build scope and repairs the active successor artifact.

evidence_items.summary: Companion and later Jira decisions rename ProcedureRequest to ServiceRequest, update the DiagnosticReport coded finding element name, refine ServiceRequest.reason wording, and separately govern Procedure.reason comments.
evidence_items.learned: These decisions define the current terminology and constrain the fix to ServiceRequest.reason comment guidance.
